$comment: Vidak ontology proposal v1 (Comment). schemaId is intentionally omitted — MetaState must assign a stable W3ID and publish this schema before W3DS_ONTOLOGY_ADAPTER_ENABLED may be turned on. Do not invent schema IDs.
title: Comment
description: User comment on a Video. Owned by the comment author's eName. Threading uses optional parentId references to other Comment MetaEnvelopes.

id.description: MetaEnvelope object id within the owner eVault (local W3ID / UUID).

ownerEName.description: Author eName (comment owner). Mapping Rules ownerEnamePath resolves to this identity.

videoId.description: Reference to the Video MetaEnvelope object id being commented on.

parentId.description: Optional parent Comment MetaEnvelope object id for replies.

visibility.description: Optional comment visibility when synchronized; defaults to public in product UX.
